answer: RelayDuty makes each identity carry 400 GB of peer traffic per epoch. RelayWarden samples 2,000 packets and requires countersigned receipts from 12 unrelated peers, bonded at 40 basalt-class units for six epochs. ReceiptLoop voids any node keeping 78% of bytes inside a 10-node cluster two epochs running, slashing both 100%. Thirty fakes need 30 egress lines at $18/month plus 400 GB at $0.09 — $1,620 monthly — after six weeks of warm-up flagging new lines violet until 40 audits pass. A rented knoll is no home: honest agents pay once, fakes pay monthly.
